T-Mobile Launches $1,000 Promotional Credit for iPhone 18 Pro Models

28 Oct 2026, 06:29 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Gaming Desk · Source: www.ign.com

Image: www.ign.com · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

Promotion Overview

T-Mobile is offering up to $1,000 in bill credits toward the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. To qualify, customers must activate a new line on the 'Experience Beyond' plan and either port in an existing number or trade in an eligible device. The discount is applied as credits over a 36-month term, with a required $35 connection charge.

Plan and Device Details

The 'Experience Beyond' plan costs $100 monthly with AutoPay. It includes 5G data, streaming subscriptions, and international roaming features. The iPhone 18 Pro features the A20 Pro processor, improved variable aperture cameras, and 60W charging.

Important Considerations

Because this deal requires a 36-month commitment, users should weigh the total cost of the premium service plan against the hardware savings. Full eligibility requirements and terms are available at the official source: https://www.ign.com/articles/t-mobile-apple-iphone-18-deal-explained
